goal.source_text: Make the fins at least 25% lighter without adding drag. Keep the stability margin at least 1.5 calibers and the flutter margin at least 1.5. You can change anything except the fin count.

constraints.label: At least 25% lighter than current 60.264 g
No increase in drag over current 9.7832 N

assumptions: Darwin may change root_chord, taper_ratio, semi_span, sweep_deg, thickness, edge_profile; it holds fin_count fixed.
Mass limit applies to all fins (fin_mass_total_g), not per fin; 25% lighter gives 45.198 g.
'Without adding drag' means drag_n must not exceed the current 9.7832 N.
Fin count is held at its current value of 3 since it may not change.
Stability margin target of 1.5 cal overrides the default 1.0 cal hard constraint.

payload.lesson: Reducing root chord lowers mass without hurting stability or flutter when span is unchanged.
